authority: CYA Wellbeing Champion — Paid Pilot & Enablement System
status: evidence-design-complete; buyer validation and paid pilot not yet authorised

objectives.objective: Test whether a supported internal activation contact improves awareness, access, communication quality and sustained participation in a real CYA program.
Validate a separately priced, partner-led enablement product in a real buyer and learner context without allowing technology production to precede buyer validation.

pilotShape.scope: One site, unit or defined cohort

minimumEntryConditions: Real cohort and defined program context
Protected paid time for the Champion and realistic participation access for workers
Written data, privacy, consent and intellectual-property terms
Locked evaluation questions and collection plan before delivery
Separate commercial scope for CYA program value and eLearning Studio validation

does: Help colleagues understand available formats and access routes
Collect or route voluntary, privacy-safe feedback
Maintain contact with the sponsor and CYA partner lead
doesNot: Own employee wellbeing or participation outcomes
Identify, assess, control or investigate psychosocial hazards
Receive or manage complaints, disclosures, bullying or harassment matters
Perform HR, WHS, EAP, counselling or mental-health-care functions
Monitor individual wellbeing, health status or platform behaviour

questions: Did eligible workers receive and understand the invitation?
Did access improve across relevant locations, schedules or formats?
Which communications and support actions were actually used?
Was the Champion role workable within protected paid time?
What should continue, change or stop?
Did the enablement experience solve a real buyer and learner problem independently of CYA program performance?
allowedMeasures: Support requests and completion friction for the enablement product

futureAssets: An anonymised pilot method and lessons article
A buyer-facing Champion role and safeguards explainer
A separate eLearning Studio validation record
publicationGates: Paid pilot completed against the locked evaluation plan
No causal, clinical, productivity or compliance claims
CYA program evidence and eLearning Studio evidence reported separately
